results.snippet: The initiative comes at a time when mining remains a major contributor to Mali's economy. In 2024, the sector accounted for 9.5% of GDP and 78.8% of export revenue. Mining companies paid CFA940 billion ($1.6 billion) to the government in 2025, while gold exports reached CFA2.75 trillion, according to Malian authorities.
